coverage_decisions.decision: Reviewed all three PMT subsections and all matching SR pages. Retained full salt, titration and electrolysis methods with diagrams. Developed ranking evidence, steam conditions, acid amount, endpoints, charge balancing and electrode assumptions. Rejected PMT copper-reacts-slowly-with-dilute-acid table, water-final burette rinse, 100 cm³ starting requirement and generic single-halogen half-equation. Standard aqueous product rules remain explicitly scoped to inert electrodes.
